item.title: Snip, snap: Bloomington’s temperature whiplash
item.description: It’s October 18, and it’s suddenly cold. Just a few days ago, I was enjoying the sunshine and warm air. It almost felt like summer! Now it’s hard to step outside without a jacket, and I’m mad at myself for not spending more time outdoors while it was warm. Then, today, I saw this post from BAM Weather: warmer-than-normal temperatures are expected to return to the Midwest and Plains after the chilly weekend.

item.title: AAG 2026 and AirBnBs without AC
item.description: I was in San Francisco between March 17 and 21 for the annual American Association of Geographers (AAG) conference, and I stayed in an Airbnb. I was excited to stay in sunny California, and escape the Indiana’s snowy weather, but was surprised by how much hotter SF was in comparison. I was greeted by a “heat advisory” in effect until the end of the week. I loved walking along the streets, enjoying tram rides, even though I was sweaty outdoors.
